how_value_is_shown: Split screens place illustrated versions of the girl beside real photos of her in the same clothes (from about 4.7 s). White headline text explains the steps: "מכניסים תמונה של הילד/ה", name and age, choose from many stories, the children become the heroes, and the text can be edited.
demonstration: No ordering flow or website is shown in the frames viewed. The demonstration is the printed book being read and handled by mother and daughter.
proof: Side-by-side comparisons of the child's real photos with illustrated characters, and the child reacting to and reading from her own book. No numbers, no outcomes, no before/after of a behaviour.
emotion: Delight, surprise, warmth between mother and daughter; text claims about confidence and values.
personal_story: Not told as a story. The mother reads the book aloud and the girl joins; the story told in the book is about the girl helping animals. Mother's own words about the product are in the headline text.
selling_language: Headline text: "עם Mebook.ai זה אפשרי ובקלות"; "אפשר גם לערוך, לשנות ולהוסיף מה שרוצים!"; "תעניקו להם תחושת מסוגלות". Caption: "שימו לב יש 10% הנחה! עם הקוד TALLY10".

audio.natural_sound: Mother reading aloud and the girl speaking in the scene, per the subtitles; the machine transcript is too garbled to confirm wording.

captions_on_screen: Two text layers: bold white headline text at top (POV hook, then the explainer script about how to order and the benefits) and beige burned-in subtitles lower in frame that follow the spoken reading and the girl's remarks. Split-screen illustration captions in a third style.
editing_rhythm: 39 detected cuts over 125 s (average about 3.2 s), alternating between two filming locations and many split-screen or inset illustrations. Long for a Reel, no speed ramps seen.
ending_and_cta: Last frames not individually inspected beyond about 2:03.5: pink bedroom wall, mother and girl reading, subtitle mid-sentence. Caption CTA is a discount code, no comment-a-word or link in bio.
price_or_code: 10% discount with code TALLY10 (caption). No price shown.
convincing: Interpretation: the real-photo vs illustrated pairs are the clearest proof that the book looks like the child, and the girl's excited face at the start sells the emotion in one frame.
weak_or_overproduced: Interpretation: at 125 s the Reel is long with a lot of read-aloud story text that is about the book's story, not the product; the explainer is in headline text rather than natural speech. The machine transcript is unusable so spoken content cannot be checked.
lumebook_lesson: Interpretation: open on the child's reaction face when the book appears, add one text hook such as a POV line, and show the real photo beside the illustrated page. A phone and a sofa are enough. Keep it far shorter: the comparison pairs and the reaction would work in 20 to 30 seconds.
not_verified: The exact spoken words (machine transcript is garbled); the last 2 seconds; whether the caption code is the only CTA; whether the child's story page images were generated for this child; the identity and speaker of each voice.
